ITEM 1 | Pale green zucchini-like rounds and wedges with dark green skin edges, some cut into half-moons and quarters, glossy with light sheen, slightly softened, spread across left-center of plate, about 14 cm across | 110
ITEM 2 | Yellow-gold summer squash pieces, thin half-moon slices and wedges with bright yellow skin, lightly glossy, sitting among the green pieces on left side | 45
ITEM 3 | Cauliflower florets, creamy white with slightly speckled tan tips, firm, bite-sized clusters about 2–3 cm each, clustered along lower-left of plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Flatbread slices, golden-brown with browned blistered edges, topped with red tomato sauce and melted white cheese with darker browned spots, cut into rectangular pieces, upper-right corner of plate | 140
ITEM 5 | Tomato sauce, reddish-orange smears on the flatbread surface, slightly glossy and thick | 15
ITEM 6 | Cubed roasted potatoes, golden-brown and crisp-edged with green herb flecks, about 2–3 cm cubes, dry-looking surface, sitting in center-right of plate | 90
ITEM 7 | Shredded white cooked chicken or fish-like flakes, pale cream with slight sheen and light browning at edges, soft and moist, piled right of center near the potatoes, about 6 cm across | 70
